close_reason: Folded into JMAP-06zp.3.1 (commit 73ec426): trait + helpers written together to avoid dead-import warnings; all acceptance criteria already met.
description:
Build on .3.1 scaffolding. Implement the MetadataBackend trait (extends JmapBackend) with the full method set:

- create_object<O: SetObject>(caller, account_id, create_id, obj) -> Result<(Id, O), BackendSetError>
- update_object<O: SetObject>(caller, account_id, id, patch) -> Result<Option<O>, BackendSetError>
- destroy_object<O: SetObject>(caller, account_id, id) -> Result<(), BackendSetError>
- supports_type<O: JmapObject>() -> bool

Cookie-cut from jmap-sharing-server::backend::SharingBackend.

helpers.rs (already stubbed in .3.1): finalize SetAccumulators / finalize_set_response / set_error_value implementations matching the sharing/filenode pattern.

## Acceptance
- cargo check -p jmap-metadata-server clean
- cargo clippy -p jmap-metadata-server -- -D warnings clean
- cargo doc -p jmap-metadata-server --no-deps clean
- MetadataBackend trait is doc-commented identically in spirit to SharingBackend

## Out of scope
- Method handler bodies (.3.3)
- Memory backend (.3.4)

## Depends on
JMAP-06zp.3.1
